about: The falsifiers of a generic rebirth. A leaf a hand changed after the fold rendered it is named by the fixed point; a release that carries the attest another key signed at the last birth turns its own clone's verify grey, since that attest is by a key the clone's lock no longer names; and a release built from the last release's leaves instead of the tree's loses what the tree grew since, a law and its samples.
